metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: (mean sampled off-diagonal item cosine + 1)/2; 0.5 means mean cosine zero. Not collapse probability or accuracy. Null when undefined/nonfinite.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_support: Mapped catalog items excluding padding, sampled items and nonfinite catalog embeddings.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative score over finite nonpadding positions with both targets nonzero; scale dependent.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank tenth percentile on the same supported pairs.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of supported margins strictly below zero; not HR@10.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of supported margins below 0.5; scale dependent.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:all_position_support: Position comparisons and finite exclusions from at most four batches and 32 rows/batch; stable user identities unavailable for these loader rows.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Category annotations unavailable; measured low/wrong position totals retained, category lists empty.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:training_candidate_stress_: Frozen fitted-training-target audit, not a holdout or benchmark evaluation. Primary pools exclude model-visible prefix items and the target, never later events; target is reinserted once. All four conditions require 99 unique competitors and share finite-prefix exclusions. Five draws are averaged within prefix, prefixes within identified user, users within this category. Rank uses exact score equality and ascending mapped ID tie breaks; hit10 is rank<=10 and reciprocal rank is 1/rank. Margin is target score minus maximum competitor score. Known-positive conflict fractions use only later training events. Uniform draws are without replacement. Frequency draws use sequential remaining-count**0.75 probabilities, not marginal inclusion probabilities. Prefix lexical queries average visible occurrences; target lexical queries are explicitly oracle-conditioned. TF-IDF is fitted only on public mapped titles/descriptions; fitted vectorizers, coverage, candidate similarities and fallback counts are trial-local artifacts. Catalog selection prespecifies each selected user's earliest manifest prefix; excluded prefixes are counted and never replaced. Lexical query support counts prefixes once; query rates and overlap quantiles are descriptive prefix-weighted summaries. For catalog size N and total-order target rank r, expected uniform sampled hit10 is Hypergeom(N-1,r-1,99).cdf(9). Empirical calibration reuses exact-catalog scores; primary-versus-catalog numerical rank discrepancies are recorded separately. Rank quantiles pool draws descriptively; they are not independent-user uncertainty estimates. Paired percentile intervals resample identified users 1000 times, retaining their prefixes/draws; conditional on fitted model and frozen artifacts. Empty groups return null and zero support. Four-category macro aggregation is unavailable in a single-category view. No training intervention, score fusion, extra fitted predictor or evaluator change is performed.
